CycleVitalSign.32: Ulac ucal ummid yiwen: yal lǧism yesɛa arrad-is, u arrad-a yezmer ad yettbeddil cwiṭ seg yiwen n wayyur ɣer wayeḍ. Ucal yettwaḥseb d amagnu, s umata, mi ara yeṭṭef gar 21 d 35 n wussan, u lḥid yettwaɣ, s umata, gar 3 d 7 n wussan.

CycleVitalSign.37: Ṭṭṛaḥ yeqwan neɣ yettqimen akken ur yelli

CycleVitalSign.42: Ibeddilen-a zemren, kra n tikkal, ad ilin d iseggwen n waṭas n yimsedwa, war ma llan d ugur:
CycleVitalSign.43: Wagi kan d kra n tfaṛasin yezmer ad ilin ger wiyaḍ: ur rrint ara tallelt n unaẓur n tezmert.
CycleVitalSign.45: Aru n yemyagen-ik, usemmiḍ neɣ amek i tḥussed ttɛawan ad tissneḍ tiɣawsiwin-ik, ayyur deffir wayeḍ.

CycleVitalSign.47: Yelha ad tesɛuḍ isteqsiyen ɣef ucal-ik. Asuter n tallelt n ṭṭbib yezmer ad yelhu deg kra n waddaden, am:

ExerciseCycleSupport.6: Acuɣer armud n lǧism yemṣaḥen yezmer ad yɛawen amsawal n ucal-ik, anaw n usmuddu ara tferneḍ, d amek ara tmesleḍ arrad-ik war ṭṭṛaḥ neɣ ccek.
ExerciseCycleSupport.7: Ur d-yeɛni ara ad txedmeḍ ugar, maca ad tddut s wudem i k-yemṣaḥen u izemren ad yeṭṭef deg wakud.
ExerciseCycleSupport.9: Acuɣer asmuddu yezmer ad yɛawen ucal-ik
ExerciseCycleSupport.18: Armud n lǧism yemṣaḥen yesɛa azal ɣef waṭas n yinagan n lǧism, ɣer-s wid yeqqnen ɣer usenmeḍ n hormone d amek i teddu ucal n lḥid. Yettɛawan s umata ɣef tuḥsest n insulin, aḥrez n stres, d ccan n unyal — kraḍ n wayen yemxalafen d umsawal n hormone.
ExerciseCycleSupport.19: Asmuddu yemṣaḥen ur d-yeḍmen ara ucal “ilhan akk”, maca d yiwet seg tiɣawsiwin i d-yettaken tazmert tamatut yelhan, u izemren ad banen deg ucal i kra n tilawin.
ExerciseCycleSupport.21: Aseɣwen gar armud n lǧism d ucal d ayen i yal yiwen: kra ttwalint ibeddilen ibanen, wiyaḍ cwiṭ. Deg wudem yiwen, tecciqt n wudem yelhan.
ExerciseCycleSupport.22: Armud yemṣaḥen yezmer ad d-yefk lfayda deg waṭas n yinagan, war ma llan ibeddilen-a ttwaḍmanen neɣ yemṣaḥen i wid akk:
ExerciseCycleSupport.24: Ad yɛawen asenmeḍ n sukkar deg idammen
ExerciseCycleSupport.29: Ad yesnerni, deg kra n tilawin, asmudd ilhan ugar n ucal
ExerciseCycleSupport.30: Lfayda-a ttemmal kra kra: mačči d ayen ara d-yeḍru ɣef lqaɛa deffir yiwet n tikkelt.
ExerciseCycleSupport.31: Ulac armud “yelhan” ugar n wayeḍ: win yelhan ugar d win i teḥemmleḍ ad txedmeḍ s uḍfar.
ExerciseCycleSupport.38: Ulac ɣer-s ameqqran: ayen yesɛan azal ameqqran d uḍfar, mačči d lqedd n ukemmel. Ad tsekcmeḍ cwiṭ n wumud deg wass-ik (aseggwer, ulli n tisurar, asemman) yesɛa azal am tmellalt yettwagedlen.
ExerciseCycleSupport.39: Lqedd ilaqen yettkel ɣef uswir n tazmert-ik, tezmert-ik, tazmert-ik deg wakud, d tinniyin-ik: ayen yelhan i yiwen ur yelhi ara yakan i wayeḍ.
ExerciseCycleSupport.41: Kraḍ n tseddiyin timecṭuḥin deg ddurt, yeṭṭfen deg wakud, yelhan ugar n uɣref ameqqran yettwaǧǧan deffir kra n wussan.
ExerciseCycleSupport.42: Tazmert d uɛebbi n lǧism zemren ad beddlen deg ucal. Aseffeḍ n uswir n armud-ik ɣef wayen i d-tḥussed d ayen yettwaqbel.
ExerciseCycleSupport.43: Deg lḥid-ik: armud afessas ma yella yemṣaḥ-ik
ExerciseCycleSupport.44: Deffir lḥid-ik: rnu kra kra ma tezmer tazmert-ik
ExerciseCycleSupport.45: Zdat ovulation: eǧǧ armud amagnu ɣef wayen i k-yelhan
ExerciseCycleSupport.46: Uqbel lḥid-ik: fren armud yezmer ad yettwazzel, u nnefsu ma yella ilaq
ExerciseCycleSupport.47: Wagi mačči d ilugan n ufizyulujya yeṭṭfen: yal tameṭṭut tḥuss ucal-is s wudem yemxalaf, u tiktiwin-a d tamawt, mačči d lwajib.
ExerciseCycleSupport.48: I tilawin yesɛan PCOS, armud n lǧism yemṣaḥen yezmer ad yelhu s wudem uslig: yettɛawan tuḥsest n insulin, amsel i yettwaḥekkmen aṭas deg waddad-a, u izemren ad yɛawen metabolism d hormone deg wakud ucrik.
ExerciseCycleSupport.50: Wagi mačči d ddwa, maca d tallelt tuzzligt i uḥrez amatu, ilaq ad tt-tmesleḍ d unaẓur n tezmert.
ExerciseCycleSupport.51: Kra n tiktiwin neɣ n tiɣawsiwin zemren ad rnunt ugar n uguren:
ExerciseCycleSupport.53: Ad tḥesbeḍ belli armud aqerrab kan i yelhan
ExerciseCycleSupport.54: Armud kan akken ad tsenqeḍ azal
ExerciseCycleSupport.56: Ad tḥussed d tabɣiḍt deffir tseddi i d-tettuḍ
ExerciseCycleSupport.57: Deg kra n waddaden, tallelt n unaẓur n tezmert tesɛa azal uqbel ad tkemmleḍ neɣ ad tbeddeleḍ armud:
ExerciseCycleSupport.63: Aɛawed n umud deffir lḥemla neɣ tlalit
ExerciseCycleSupport.64: Kra n waddad anda armud yettwazgel s uṭṭbib
ExerciseCycleSupport.66: Asmuddu ur ilaq ara ad yili yeqwan neɣ ummid akken ad yelhu. Armud yemṣaḥen, yelhan, u izemren ad yeṭṭef yezmer ad yɛawen tazmert-ik tamatut u ad yɛawen, deg kra n tilawin, ad tesɛuḍ aḥrez ilhan ugar n ucal.
ExerciseCycleSupport.68: Amagrad-a d i ussenfar amatu kan u ur yettekkes ara tallelt n ṭṭbib. Seggem dima armud ɣer waddad-ik, u suter tallelt n unaẓur n tezmert ma tesɛiḍ ccek.
ExerciseCycleSupport.69: Ddu akken ad tɛawneḍ ucal-ik — AWA

FastingQadaa.6: Amek d melmi ara tuɣaleḍ ussan n ṣṣum i d-tuɣ, s arrad-ik u war ṭṭṛaḥ.
FastingQadaa.8: Agbur-a d aselmad kan. Isteqsiyen n ddin ilaq ad ttwasnen s ɛulama yettwasnen. AWA ur tefk ara fetwa neɣ ahat n ddin yuzzlen.
FastingQadaa.10: Melmi ara tuɣaleḍ ussan i d-tuɣ?
FastingQadaa.11: Wakud amatu: uqbel Ramaḍan i d-iteddun
FastingQadaa.14: Qadaa d tuɣalin, deg wakud-nniḍen, n wussan n ṣṣum i d-tuɣ deg Ramaḍan — s wudem uslig ssebba n lḥid. Ussan-a ilaq ad ttwaɛawden acku ṣṣum n Ramaḍan yeqqim d tcuba n wayyur, u ussan i yeqqimen ssebba n lḥid ttwaḥsaben d ayen yellan, war ma tella tuccḍa seg-m.
FastingQadaa.15: Tuɣalin tezmer ad tebdu, s umata, mi ara yeččur Ramaḍan, mi ara yeǧǧ waddad-ik. Tzemreḍ ad tesmunteḍ ussan-a s arrad-ik: kra ḥemmlen ad ten-sdukklen zik deffir Ramaḍan, wiyaḍ ten-sfeḍen kra kra deg wayyuren i d-iteddun.
FastingQadaa.17: Tuɣalin n wussan gar-asen neɣ ad ten-tesfeḍ tezmer ad tettwali d ayen yemxalafen ɣef tmadrasin n fiqh; yiwen seg sin ur yettwaḥseb ara d win kan yelhan dagi.
FastingQadaa.18: Aru amḍan amatu n wussan ara tuɣaleḍ mi ara yeččur Ramaḍan
FastingQadaa.19: Fren tarrayt tifessast: tafelwit, asnas, ajenwi
FastingQadaa.20: Rnu aderrer ɣef yal ass i tuɣaleḍ
FastingQadaa.21: Am wawal, win yesɛan 6 n wussan ara iɛawed izmer ad iṣum yiwen deg ddurt ɣef setta n ddurin, neɣ ad ten-isdukkel deg yiwen n wakud ma yelha-yas.
FastingQadaa.22: D ayen amagnu ad tɛerḍeḍ ad tuɣaleḍ ussan i d-tuɣ uqbel Ramaḍan i d-iteddun. Aɛebbi-a mačči d lwajib dima deg yal addad, maca yessefk asmunteg u yessenqes alluy n waṭas n wussan i d-yeqqimen.
FastingQadaa.24: Asfeḍ n wussan ara tuɣaleḍ ɣef lǧadwal-ik yeǧǧa-ak ad tkemmleḍ s lehna, war ṭṭṛaḥ.
FastingQadaa.25: Aheggi zik yettɛawan ad nezzeh uḥezzeb n tegara. Tarrayt tifessast d ukkes n wussan i d-yeqqimen uqbel Ramaḍan i d-iteddun u asfeḍ n wussan ara tuɣaleḍ ɣef ddurin neɣ ayyuren yellan.
FastingQadaa.27: Ma yella ssebba yettqimen neɣ i d-yettɛawaden yeǧǧa ṣṣum (waddad n tezmert yeṭṭfen, am wawal), addad yezmer ad yekcem ɣer uɣerbaz-nniḍen; yelha ad tmeslayeḍ ɣef waya d ɛalem yettwasnen.
FastingQadaa.29: Ilugan n tidet ma yella wakud iɛedda zemren ad xtalfen ɣef tefsit. I yal addad uɛeqqed, rray n ɛalem yettwasnen yeqqim d win n uwal.
FastingQadaa.30: Am wawal, ma yebda Ramaḍan i d-iteddun deg 8 n wayyuren u qqimen 6 n wussan ara tuɣaleḍ, yiwen n usnulfu d ad tesɣuḍeḍ ɣef yiwen wass deg wayyur, s uɛebbi i wayen ur nettwaqbal ara.
FastingQadaa.31: Lḥemla d tizuzin zemren ad ḥekmen ɣef tezmert n ṣṣum, s wudem uslig ma yella ṣṣum yesɛa ṭer i tezmert n yemma neɣ n uqcic amecṭuḥ. Tazmert n lǧism d tezmert tideț i ṣṣum d tiwsatin yesɛan azal.
FastingQadaa.33: Waddaden-a ttwassnen deg ddin d ayen izemren ad d-yefk azgen.
FastingQadaa.34: Ibeddilen n ddin ɣef ṣṣum ur yettwaḥbes ara deg lḥemla neɣ tizuzin zemren ad xtalfen ɣef tmadrasin, s wudem uslig ɣef yisteqsi n wanda tuɣalin tifessast tekfa neɣ ma yella daɣen tella tafkarit. Ssebba n wayen ur yettwaṣum ara d waddad udmawan zemren ad beddlen tiririt tilemmast.
FastingQadaa.36: Qadaa yeǧǧa-ak ad tuɣaleḍ ussan n ṣṣum i d-tuɣ s lehna, s arrad-ik. Deg waddad uslig (wakud iɛedda, lḥemla, tizuzin, aɛeqqel yettqimen), rray n ɛalem yettwasnen yeqqim d win ilhan akk.

FertilityWindow.6: Acuɣer ussan ɣer yidis n ovulation d wid yesɛan azal ameqqran i lḥemla.
FertilityWindow.10: Amek ara tissneḍ tegwejdit-ik n tazdayt
FertilityWindow.12: Tegwejdit n tazdayt d tallest n ucal-ik anda lḥemla tezmer ad teḍru. Tezmer ad tili amzun 6 n wussan: 5 n wussan uqbel ovulation, d wass n ovulation s timmad-is.
FertilityWindow.14: Yal ucal yemxalaf: tegwejdit n tazdayt ur tettili ara dima deg yiwen n wass n tenwalt seg yiwen n wayyur ɣer wayeḍ.
FertilityWindow.15: Aɣbalu n lemni yezmer ad yeqqim ɣer 5 n wussan deg wabrid n tgemmi, ayen yerran tallest anda lḥemla tezmer ad teḍru teɣzi ugar. Tamellalt, deg wakud-nni, tezmer ad tettwafres ala amzun 24 n tsaɛtin deffir ma d-tefeɣ.
FertilityWindow.16: Am wawal, tameddurt i d-yeḍran 3 n wussan uqbel ovulation tezmer ad tebnu lḥemla, u tameddurt n wass deffir ovulation, aṭas n tikkal, tuɣ-d ticki.
FertilityWindow.17: Aṭas n tiwsatin, ma ttwaẓrent d tamuɣli yiwen, ttɛawanent ad tfeḍleḍ tallest-a ugar:
FertilityWindow.20: Amedrar n temdit n ddaw n lǧism-ik
FertilityWindow.23: Asmunteg n waṭas n tiwsatin (ucal, mucus, temdit) yefka tamuɣli tummidt ugar n tegwejdit-ik n tazdayt d yiwet n tiwsatin weḥd-s.
FertilityWindow.24: Tegwejdit n tazdayt: amek teddu — AWA

FiqhWomenIntro.37: Talɣut tamidyant ɣef ucal (teɣzi, tiwsatin, isurifen n hormone) d ilugan n ddin i d-yeḍfaren (ṭṭahara, ṣṣlat, ṣṣum) rran i sin n yiwsawen yemxalafen: yiwen yessemgirred asenfar n tmeẓri, wayeḍ yesbadu asbaɣur i umud n tmerniwt. Sin zemren ad sdukklen, maca ur ilaq ara ad ttwasemmgiren.
FiqhWomenIntro.39: Aḍfar n ucal s tmeẓri d tamarkiwin n ddin i d-yeḍfaren sɛan yal yiwen tamuɣli yelhan.
FiqhWomenIntro.41: Anaẓur n tezmert yezmer ad yerr ɣef yisteqsiyen n tmeẓri; ɛalem yettwasnen yeqqim d win yelhan akk i yisteqsiyen n ddin.
FiqhWomenIntro.42: AWA tɛawen iseqdacen ad fehmen ucal-nsen, gar tazmert d umud n ddin, s wudem n tselmadt yeḥrez amgirred gar tmadrasin.
FiqhWomenIntro.43: Fhem tikti igejdanen n fiqh n tilawin
FiqhWomenIntro.44: Fhem ucal-ik ugar, seg tmuɣli n tmeẓri d tin n ddin
FiqhWomenIntro.45: Af isteqsiyen ilaqen rray n ɛalem yettwasnen
FiqhWomenIntro.46: Af abrid-ik gar yimgirraden n madhahib war tuffra
FiqhWomenIntro.47: Kcem ɣer yisfuqqen n tselmadt yewhiwen u yettwasen
FiqhWomenIntro.48: Seggem talɣut n tmeẓri seg usenfar n ddin
FiqhWomenIntro.49: Ḍfer talɣut ilhan i umud-ik n ddin, ma yella ilaq
FiqhWomenIntro.50: Heggi isteqsiyen uslig ara tesqseḍ ɛalem yettwasnen
FiqhWomenIntro.52: AWA d afecku n tselmadt d tnisit: ur tettekkes ara, deg yal waddad, rray n ɛalem yettwasnen neɣ n tallelt n ddin.
FiqhWomenIntro.53: Kra n waddaden ilaqen ad ttwaḍḍerren ɣer ɛalem i tettkelleḍ fell-as, s wudem uslig mi ara:
FiqhWomenIntro.54: Waddad udmawan ur yemṣaḥ ara d yiwen n tmeẓlit (idammen ur nelhi ara, ccek ucrik...)
FiqhWomenIntro.55: Aṭas n yiṛayen ttbanen msellalen u ur tessneḍ ara anwa ara tḍefreḍ
FiqhWomenIntro.56: Asenfar n ddin yesɛa azal ameqqran ɣef umud-ik n yal ass
FiqhWomenIntro.57: Tḥussed tesɛiḍ ilaq n usnerni ilaqen i waddad-ik udmawan
FiqhWomenIntro.59: Fiqh n tilawin d tazwara tettidin n usefru, s yiṛayen yemxalafen kra n tikkal gar tmadrasin. AWA tɛawen-ak ad tfehmeḍ igejdan u ad tsegmeḍ isteqsiyen-ik, maca rray n ɛalem yettwasnen yeqqim d win n uwal i yal asenfar udmawan n ddin.

FirstPeriodComing.1:
Amek ara ssneɣ ma yella
lḥid-iw amezwaru ittaweḍ?
FirstPeriodComing.6: Kra n tiwsatin tideț zemrent ad k-ɛawnent ad tessneḍ belli lḥid-ik amezwaru yeqreb tidet.
FirstPeriodComing.10: Tuffɣa n wadeg n tmeṭṭut neɣ idammen n lḥid?
FirstPeriodComing.11: Melmi ilaq ad tmeslayeḍ d yiwen n ameqqran?
FirstPeriodComing.13: Tuffɣa tafessast, tafeɣ, tettban kra n wayyuren uqbel.
FirstPeriodComing.15: Tawsit yettwasnen yettbanen, s umata, aṭas uqbel lḥid.
FirstPeriodComing.17: Tuḥsest timecṭuḥin am wa zemrent ad ssekniwent belli lḥid-ik yeqreb.
FirstPeriodComing.18: Uqbel ma d-yas lḥid-ik amezwaru, d ayen amagnu ad twalid tuffɣa tafessast tamellalt neɣ tamellalt cwiṭ n tazegzawt deg yilebsan-ik. Wagi d ayen amagnu, yeqqnen ɣer urmud n hormone i yebdan deg lǧism-ik.
FirstPeriodComing.19: Tuffɣa n wadeg n tmeṭṭut tafessast neɣ tamellalt, war tazart tameqqrant. Idammen n lḥid, deg wudem-nni, d azegzaw ɣer aberkan u ssekniwen tazwara tideț n lḥid-ik. Ma tesɛiḍ ccek, ur d-yettili ara d ayen ameqqran ad tmeslayeḍ ɣef waya.
FirstPeriodComing.21: Ulac abrid ad tissneḍ wass ummid. Ad tesɛuḍ aḥerres yidek seg tiwsatin timezwura d aɣawas ilhan akk.
FirstPeriodComing.22: S tutlayt n tiwsatin-a, neɣ ma tesɛiḍ asteqsi neɣ uḥezzeb, tzemreḍ ad tmeslayeḍ d yemma-k, d weltma-k, d wid i k-yezzin, neɣ d unaẓur n tezmert i tettkelleḍ fell-as. Ulac wakud ur nelhi ara ad tessutureḍ tallelt.

FirstPeriodDailyLife.1:
Amek ara tmesleḍ lḥid-ik
amezwaru yal ass?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.6: S kra n tiɣawsiwin timecṭuḥin, lḥid-ik amezwaru ad yekcem s lehna ɣer tudert-ik n yal ass, deg uɣerbaz d kra n wadeg-nniḍen.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.9: Aheggi n tqeffalt tamecṭuḥt n uzaglu
FirstPeriodDailyLife.10: Ma yella lḥid-ik d-yusa war ma tettṛaǧuḍ
FirstPeriodDailyLife.11: Aɣerbaz, armud, anyal: lḥid-ik ur k-yeḥbis ara seg ugerrez n yimagen-ik n yal ass. Ilaq kan ad tbeddleḍ kra n tiɣawsiwin akken ad tḥussed s tawsit deg wass.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.12: Aɣerbaz neɣ armud: eǧǧ aḥerres neɣ tampon deg tqeffalt-ik
FirstPeriodDailyLife.13: Armud: tzemreḍ ad tmuddeḍ, kan ssenqes arrad
FirstPeriodDailyLife.14: Anyal: aḥerres n yiḍ yemṣaḥen yekfa
FirstPeriodDailyLife.15: Tqeffalt tamecṭuḥt s yiwen neɣ sin n yiḥerrasen neɣ n tampon, ajeddig n ilebsan d kra n yimecḍiwen tezmer ad tkcem s lehna ɣer tqeffalt n uɣerbaz neɣ n armud. Ittɛawan ad tḥussed s tawsit mebla acu ara d-yeḍru.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.17: Ad tesɛuḍ dima aḥerres neɣ tampon yidek ad yeḥrez aḥezzeb n tfaja.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.18: Wagi yeḍra aṭas, s wudem uslig deg tazwara. Tamsiwelt n uɣerbaz, aselmad, neɣ ameddakel almi ar yesɛa kra n wayen izemren ad yɛawen. Ad tessiwḍeḍ aqeṭṭun n ukudiy ɣef yiri-ik izemmer daɣen ad yelhu alamma ara tafeḍ aḥerres neɣ tampon.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.20: Anwa aḥerres neɣ tampon ara fren i lḥid-iw amezwaru?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.24: Lḥid-iw amezwaru ur yemṣaḥ ara: d amagnu wagi?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.26: Amek ara tmesleḍ lḥid-ik amezwaru yal ass? — AWA

FirstPeriodFaq.1:
Isteqsiyen i d-yettwaqeblen aṭas
ɣef lḥid-ik amezwaru
FirstPeriodFaq.6: Tririyin tifessasin i yisteqsiyen i d-yettwaqeblen aṭas ɣef lḥid-ik amezwaru.
FirstPeriodFaq.8: “D amagnu ma yella cwiṭ kan n idammen?”
FirstPeriodFaq.9: Ih. Icaluyen imezwura aṭas n tikkal sɛan usemmiḍ afessas. Usemmiḍ yezmer ad yettbeddil seg yiwen n wucal ɣer wayeḍ, s wudem uslig deg tazwara.
FirstPeriodFaq.10: “D amagnu ma yella aṭas n idammen?”
FirstPeriodFaq.11: Usemmiḍ ameqqran yezmer daɣen ad yeḍru, s wudem uslig deg sin n wussan imezwura. Ma tesɛiḍ ilaq ad tbeddeleḍ aḥerres-ik ugar n yiwet n tikkelt deg tsaɛt ɣef kra n tsaɛtin yeddan, yelha ad tmeslayeḍ d unaẓur n tezmert ɣef waya.
FirstPeriodFaq.12: “D amagnu ma tesɛiḍ ṭṭṛaḥ n tebuqqet?”
FirstPeriodFaq.13: Ṭṭṛaḥ afessas deg uḍar n tebuqqet d amagnu u s umata ur d-yeɛni ara aɣilif. Taqerɛet n waman iḥemmuyen neɣ cwiṭ n unefsu zemren ad ɛawen. Ṭṭṛaḥ yeqwan aṭas yelha ad tmeslayeḍ ɣef-s.
FirstPeriodFaq.15: Ih, tzemreḍ ad tmuddeḍ deg lḥid-ik. Kan seggem uswir ɣer wamek i d-yettḥuss lǧism-ik deg wass-nni.
FirstPeriodFaq.17: Ih, tzemreḍ ad tɛumeḍ s uḥerres ilhan. Aṭas n yimdanen ttafen d ayen ilhan ad ṛǧun alamma ḥussen uṭṭun ugar.
FirstPeriodFaq.19: Ulac asteqsi ur nelhi ara: yal lǧism yemxalaf, u tzemreḍ dima ad tmeslayeḍ d win i tettkelleḍ fell-as.
FirstPeriodFaq.23: Anwa aḥerres ara fren i lḥid-iw amezwaru?
FirstPeriodFaq.27: Isteqsiyen i d-yettwaqeblen aṭas ɣef lḥid-ik amezwaru — AWA
